# Narrative 4

> Narrative 4 transforms civic engagement and empathy through Story Exchange workshops and community-led action projects that connect diverse voices across schools and organizations globally.

Narrative 4 is an educational nonprofit that uses storytelling and narrative pedagogy to build empathy, foster civic engagement, and empower students to become community leaders. The organization operates Story Exchange workshops in schools and higher education institutions worldwide, supported by research from Yale, Oxford, and Ohio State universities.

## Key Topics

- Story Exchange
- Storytelling workshops
- Empathy building
- Civic engagement
- Narrative pedagogy
